motion.name: paper-unfurl
motion.purpose: Finite native CSS animation clock sampled through the Web Animations API to drive the mesh.

motion.name: paper-middle
motion.purpose: Middle sheet moves from a tucked to a visible layer.

motion.name: paper-bottom
motion.purpose: Back sheet settles below the other sheets.

motion.name: paper-note
motion.purpose: Short paper annotation appears after the sheets begin opening.

motion.name: preview-feedback
motion.value: 600ms image transform; 250–500ms selection and focus detail
motion.purpose: Local pointer feedback in the overview.

motion.name: proof-settle
motion.purpose: The lower gallery acknowledges a decoded image replacement.

motion.name: paper-direct-peel
motion.value: mesh progress 1–2.2; pointer-captured corner drag toward upper left
motion.purpose: Mouse, touch and pen directly open the real screenshot mesh; the same native button toggles with click, Enter or Space.

motion.name: paper-settle
motion.purpose: Finite settling after a direct peel; no continuous idle rendering or automatic interaction loop.

motion.name: paper-sheet-drag
motion.purpose: Bounded direct manipulation of the rear sheets; numbered caption buttons also reveal capture, marked or finished context.

motion.name: paper-keyboard
motion.value: Left/Up open; Right/Down close; End fully open; Home/Escape restore
motion.purpose: Keyboard access to the corner and sheet states, with Escape cancelling a captured gesture and returning focus.

motion.name: paper-fallback
motion.value: authentic image shift with the same button and keyboard controls
motion.purpose: Keeps backing-sheet reveal available when WebGL or texture initialization fails.

motion.name: render-lifecycle
motion.value: finite opening or 420ms settle; direct-input redraw; idle/hidden/offscreen stop; resize redraw
motion.purpose: Bounds rendering to direct manipulation and finite transitions; replay restores the default sheet offsets and finished layer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: static initial curl; direct drag; instant click/keyboard changes; no hover lift or settle tween
motion.purpose: Preserves corner and layer controls without automatic playback; keeps the authentic-image fallback interactive.

narrative.overview:
A saturated blue field holds white type, the approved white wordmark and three overlapping screenshot sheets. The front sheet opens at its lower-right corner to show a lit white reverse; handwritten pointers explain capture, annotation and the finished result. A shallow asymmetric wave joins this material scene to a white, image-led feature overview. Following the user’s 2026-11-02 refinement, the blue hero and white sections extend to the viewport edges without an outer presentation frame or page corner radius; the centered inner content column retains its reading gutters.

The screenshot fronts remain authentic XShot interface pixels. Website annotations and paper shading are separate editorial layers. Promotional pages use this physical, expressive language; help pages retain a quiet white reading surface, shared sans typography and blue navigation. The exact approved open-corner identity remains an asset, not a shape to redraw. The recording section embeds an authentic unchanged XShot single-file HTML export; its native player styling is separate product evidence, while the surrounding toolbar, caption and links follow this website system.

This system replaces the earlier white annotation-ribbon world following the user's explicit selection on 2026-11-02. The current source and its cascade are normative. This document records the implementation, not an exact image-match or shipping verdict; comparison receipts remain in the build evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Saturated blue presentation with white type and pill actions.
Real screenshot fronts, pale sheet planes and a physically bent white reverse.
Handwritten English and Chinese pointers confined to annotation roles.
Three open feature columns immediately below a shallow white wave.
One finite opening, direct corner peeling and sheet controls with keyboard, touch and authentic-image fallback access.
An authentic offline five-step, four-hotspot HTML walkthrough, embedded without restyling its native player.

rules.name: The Field Changes the Action Rule
rules.body: Use white pills and white navigation inside the blue promotional field; use blue actions and reading links on white surfaces.

rules.name: The Handwriting Has a Pointer Rule
rules.body: Use Caveat or Zhi Mang Xing for short annotation captions and the paper note; keep paragraphs, controls and documentation in the sans family.

rules.name: The Reverse Is Material Rule
rules.body: A paper curl reveals a lit white underside and the layers behind it; preserve that material relationship rather than substituting a flat triangular overlay.

rules.name: The One Opening Rule
rules.body: Play one finite sheet-opening moment and settle; subsequent animation follows replay or a direct local interaction.

rules.name: The Export Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Embed the byte-identical native HTML export in its own titled, lazy-loaded script-only sandbox. Preserve its player styling and English content; localize the surrounding site labels and identify the English sample on the Chinese page. The frame is 16:10 with desktop 620–860px, medium minimum 560px and mobile 460px. Keep full-view and single-file download links. Its five embedded screenshots and four hotspots guide recorded states, without live app control or network dependencies.

dos: Do preserve the approved symbol and exact wordmark, choosing the white variant inside the blue hero.
Do keep real screenshot pixels, native control proportions and their provenance intact.
Do keep website annotation overlays distinct from native application controls.
Do use white pills on the blue promotional field and blue actions on white reading surfaces.
Do preserve the white reverse, soft shading and visible rear planes when extending the paper material.
Do retain keyboard states, a complete reduced-motion scene and the authentic-image fallback.
Do preserve the original exported player and its source/hash provenance; apply site tokens only to its surrounding toolbar, caption and links.
donts: Don't redraw, stretch or close the brand mark's open corner.
Don't substitute generated interface content for actual product evidence.
Don't extend handwriting into paragraphs, ordinary controls or documentation.
Don't turn the paper-opening sequence into an endless decorative loop.
Don't turn every lower section or help topic into a tilted sheet or enclosed card.
Don't describe screenshot-hotspot navigation as operating a live app, and don't restyle the authentic exported player as a website mockup.
